instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Organic vineyard and winery producing 60,000 bottles per year. Direct-to-consumer sales through wine clubs account for 45% of revenue. Seeking to modernize fermentation monitoring and explore biodynamic certification. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing — only 8% of customers created accounts. We did not invest enough in understanding whether our specific customer base actually wanted self-service before building.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

input.changes_since_last: Regulatory changes forced compliance reviews. 2 new standard procedures implemented. Team morale improving.

opportunities.title: Customer Data Platform (CDP) Implementation and CX Journey Mapping
opportunities.rationale: The failure of the self-service portal indicated a lack of foundational understanding, not technical capability. To defend market share, Cipher must shift focus from building features to gathering robust customer data across all touchpoints. A CDP will unify this view, allowing targeted digital improvements that increase switching costs and reduce churn.

first_actions: Map the current end-to-end wine club/customer lifecycle journey (digital and physical).
Identify key data silos (POS, Wine Club CRM, Website) required for customer view unification.
Define baseline KPIs for churn reduction attributable to digital engagement.
Pilot basic integration of existing systems into a centralized data repository.
resources_needed: Basic CDP tool license (or equivalent database structure)
10-20 hours dedicated Developer time per month
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in high-value customer churn rate by 5% within 12 months.
milestones: Complete detailed journey map and data gap analysis (Month 3).
Establish initial unified customer view prototype (Month 6).
Implement first targeted digital intervention based on insights (Month 12).

opportunities.title: Establish Protected Innovation Capacity and Process
opportunities.rationale: The current reliance on 'spare cycles' is unsustainable for a market leader facing structured competition. The winery needs to formalize protected time (e.g., 10% developer capacity) dedicated solely to innovation sprints, insulated from urgent operational demands. This requires owner buy-in and cultural change.

first_actions: Implement a lightweight 'Innovation Charter' defining scope, goals, and success metrics for R&D time.
Establish a quarterly internal hackathon/sprint focused on solving top 3 customer friction points identified via the CDP (opp_1).
Assign a designated operational manager to shield developer time from non-critical urgent requests.
resources_needed: Small allocated budget for proof-of-concept tools
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful completion and demonstrable value of at least two 'protected' prototypes per quarter.
milestones: Innovation Charter signed and communicated across the team (Month 1).
First successful quarterly innovation sprint completed (Month 3).

next_steps.action: Lead a workshop with key stakeholders (Sales/Marketing/Operations) to formally map the complete customer journey and define data ownership for CDP integration.
Draft a formal 'Innovation Charter' defining the protected percentage of developer time and mandatory quarterly review process.
Audit existing core systems (CRM, POS) against competitor digital features to quantify immediate technological gaps that impact customer experience.

key_weaknesses: Lack of structured process for translating competitive threats into prioritized, executable innovation backlogs.
Insufficient capacity protection: Innovation efforts are perpetually reactive and competing with urgent day-to-day operational needs.
Over-reliance on the Owner's bandwidth for setting strategic direction and removing organizational roadblocks.

improvements: Implementation of new standard procedures following regulatory changes (showing improved adherence).
Improved team morale contributing to greater willingness to participate in process improvements.
Increased available budget percentage (from 11% to 16%) providing more resources for initiatives.
persistent_gaps: The core structural weakness remains the lack of dedicated, protected time and formalized roles for innovation/R&D.
Failure to transition from MVP building to deep customer insight gathering (evidenced by self-service portal failure).
Decision making is still heavily reliant on the owner alone, slowing down iterative experimentation.
achieved_milestones: Completion of previous recommendation 'opp_2' confirms ability to execute a defined project scope.
In-progress work on 'step_2' shows commitment to process improvement and internal resource management.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company successfully implemented standard procedures due to regulatory changes and increased its allocated budget percentage (from 11% to 16%). The focus has shifted from basic capacity building to strategic market defense against well-funded competitors by prioritizing customer experience over feature parity.
